Spinach: the pile is about 270 px by 330 px, or roughly 16 x 19 cm in the image. It is loose and fairly low, perhaps 3 cm high. Loose leaves are very light, so I estimate about 45 g.

Corn cob slice: it is about 100 px across, roughly 5.5 cm, and about 2 cm thick. That works out to about 35 g.

Other small items: I see a few corn kernels or bits scattered among the leaves, and possibly a little broccoli at the edge of the pile. I estimate about 8 g for the broccoli and about 3 g for the kernels.
